proof_body:
by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => norm_num [Nat.fib_add_two]
  | succ n ih =>
    have h2 : (Nat.fib (n + 2) : ℤ) = Nat.fib n + Nat.fib (n + 1) := by
      rw [Nat.fib_add_two]
      push_cast
      ring
    have h3 : (Nat.fib (n + 1 + 2) : ℤ) = Nat.fib (n + 1) + Nat.fib (n + 2) := by
      rw [Nat.fib_add_two]
      push_cast
      ring
    have hp : (-1 : ℤ) ^ (n + 2) = -(-1) ^ (n + 1) := by ring
    rw [h3, show n + 1 + 1 = n + 2 from rfl, hp, ← ih, h2]
    ring
target_source: ∀ n : ℕ, (Nat.fib (n + 2) : ℤ) * (Nat.fib n : ℤ) - (Nat.fib (n + 1) : ℤ) ^ 2 = (-1) ^ (n + 1)
